articles.title: EU approves new rules for data portability between cloud providers
articles.summary: The regulation requires providers to support migration within thirty days and sets limits on egress fees for departing customers.
articles.author: Marta Silva

articles.title: Open-source group ships a 0.8B decision model that runs on a laptop
articles.summary: The model answers yes/no, multiple-choice, and rating questions with calibrated probabilities and no text generation.
articles.author: Jonas Weber

articles.title: Chipmaker reports record quarter on data-center demand
articles.summary: Revenue rose 38 percent year over year, and the company raised guidance for the next quarter despite supply constraints.
articles.author: Priya Nair

articles.title: Researchers find a cheaper way to recycle lithium from old batteries
articles.summary: The process uses a low-temperature solvent and recovers more than ninety percent of the lithium in laboratory tests.
articles.author: Tomas Berg
